Read one period of a manifest as a raster

Source: R/read.R
ntl_read.Rd

Reads all files of one series and one period from a manifest, crops each to the area of interest, mosaics them and extends the result to the full area so that missing tiles show up as NA instead of silently shrinking the coverage.

Usage

ntl_read(
  manifest,
  period = NULL,
  series = NULL,
  aoi = NULL,
  variable = NULL,
  flip = NA
)

Arguments

manifest

A manifest from ntl_fetch() or ntl_files().

period

Period to read ("YYYY-MM", "YYYY" or Date). May be omitted if the manifest holds a single period.

series

Series to read. May be omitted if the manifest holds a single series.

aoi

Optional area of interest (see ntl_tiles()).

variable

Value layer. Defaults to the product's value_layer (NearNadir_Composite_Snow_Free). Count and quality layers are <variable>_Num and <variable>_Quality.

flip

NA (automatic), TRUE or FALSE.

Value

A SpatRaster with layers value and, where available, nobs and quality.

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
m <- ntl_files(ex$dir, "eog_vnl_monthly")
r <- ntl_read(m, period = "2022-03", series = "eog_vnl_monthly_npp")
r
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 120, 120, 2  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.05, 0.05  (x, y)
#> extent      : 66, 72, 46, 52  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> sources     : SVDNB_npp_20220301-20220331_75N060E_vcmslcfg_v10_c000000000000.avg_rade9h.tif
#>               SVDNB_npp_20220301-20220331_75N060E_vcmslcfg_v10_c000000000000.cf_cvg.tif
#> names       :     value, nobs
#> min values  :  0.305772,    8
#> max values  : 44.075241,    8
